start.text: (He doesn't get up from the barricade.) Where are you coming from?

choices.text: The hospital. I was discharged this morning.
(Show him the slip and your ID card.)

read.text: (He reads both twice, then hands them back without looking at you.) Where are you going?

home.text: Walking? (He almost laughs.) Then go straight there. Stay inside after five.

why.text: (He looks down the empty road for a long time.) Go home.

again.text: You're still here? Go home. Before five.
